title: Users

users.caption: People of this installation
users.loadFailed: Could not load the list of people.

noMatch.title: Nobody found
noMatch.body: Change the search or reset the filters.

empty.title: No people yet
empty.body: Accounts appear after registration or by invitation.

actions.selfHint: You cannot do this to your own account.

forbidden.title: Only installation administrators can open this section
forbidden.body: People and invitations are visible to installation administrators. Ask one of them if you need access.

hints.resetLink: A one-time link to set a new password
hints.revokeAdmin: The account stays, the admin area closes
hints.enable: The person can sign in again
hints.disable: Sign-in is blocked, projects and data are kept
hints.remove: Personal data is erased for good

disable.title: Disable the account?
disable.body: {{name}} will not be able to sign in, and current sign-ins end. Projects and data are kept.

enable.title: Enable the account?
enable.body: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.

grantAdmin.title: Make administrator?
grantAdmin.body: {{name}} will get access to every admin section except project contents.

revokeAdmin.title: Remove administrator rights?
revokeAdmin.body: {{name}} will lose access to the admin area. The last administrator cannot be removed.

resetLink.title: Issue a password reset link?
resetLink.body: The link lets someone set a new password for {{name}}. The action is logged and the person is notified.

revokeSessions.title: End all sign-ins?
revokeSessions.body: {{name}} will be signed out on every device and will have to sign in again.

remove.title: Delete the account permanently?
remove.body: Personal data of {{name}} will be erased and log entries anonymized. This cannot be undone.

resetLink.title: Password reset link
resetLink.lead: Account: {{name}}. The link is valid until {{time}}.
resetLink.label: New password link
resetLink.notified: The person also received this link by email.
resetLink.manual: No email was sent: pass the link to the person yourself.

invitations.newLead: The person signs up with the link, no approval needed. With an email set, only that address can use it.
invitations.caption: Invitations

empty.title: No invitations yet
empty.body: Create an invitation and send the link to a person: they register with it.

invitations.linkFor: Send it to {{email}}: only this address can open it.
invitations.linkAnyone: Anyone you pass it to can sign up with it.

approvals.caption: Awaiting approval
approvals.loadFailed: Could not load the approval queue.

empty.title: The queue is empty
empty.body: New registrations that need an administrator's decision appear here.

approvals.lead: Until a request is approved, the person cannot sign in. A rejected account is disabled.

failure.last_admin: This is the last administrator: appoint another one first.
failure.user_has_projects: The person owns projects: transfer or delete them first.
failure.user_not_disabled: Only a disabled account can be deleted.
failure.not_found: The record was not found: it may have been changed already.
failure.forbidden: You do not have enough rights for this action.
failure.invitation_invalid: The invitation is no longer valid.
failure.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.csrf_failed: The session is out of date. Reload the page and try again.
failure.network: The server is unreachable. Check the connection and try again.
failure.unknown: The action failed. Try again later.

linkOnce: The link is shown once: after closing you cannot see it again.

passkeys.confirm: Remove all of this person's passkeys? They won't be able to sign in with them. Open sessions stay. If the person has no password or single sign-on, issue a password reset link.
